'''Fett Imperial Occupation/Imperial Control (v) Walker Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fett]]
* '''Published:''' 12 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Occupation
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed IOcc Fett DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck hasn't posted three times, and I am really tired of writing and rewriting the description.  It's all in the title.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

First off, I'll list what effects my starting stuff has on the game

1. My force drains at Hoth sites may not be canceled.
2. When I control two Hoth locations Revolution and all opponent's drain bonuses are

canceled
3. My AT-ATs deploy -1, and I can pull them, one per turn, along with TTMG, AT-AT Cannon,

or Electro-Rangefinder.
4. I can deploy two wampas my first turn.
5. My wampas are deploy -2 and ferocity +2
6. I can pull one Walker Garrison and 3rd Marker.  Once I flip, opponent starts to lose

force from YMSYL


On my first turn I activate all the force I can, pull TTMG, because I have to have that,

then I deploy One Arm to MPG (for 4).  Use him to pull wampa cave, and deploy that.  Slap

down a wampa from reserve to the Cave (for free), and draw my last force.

After that, it's pretty much just go with the flow.  This is not a pull intensive deck, so

I'll just list what combos I have

Admiral Piett pulls Battle Deployment, which lets me deploy 1 combat vehicle per turn from

reserve.

Usually I pull Blizzard 4, pull Vader, put Vader on Blizzard 1 (which wasn't beatdown on

because it doesn't have a pilot :), put Electro-Rangefinder on and I have a plus 8 to my

TTMG.  I can pull 3rd marker, which adds another one.  That alone will let me hit with a

zero.  If I control any Hoth sites, I don't have to be at 3rd marker to get a guaranteed

hit.

As soon as I deploy an AT-AT, I can pull my Star Destroyer to the system using PFASA

Imperial Command lets me pull Veers and Piett, as well as adding a battle destiny with

either of them.

When I get all my sites out, I can only drain for 3 per turn, but YMSYL adds another 5, and

I can add another Ten to force drains with Walker Garrison.

I don't know which Star Destroyer to use yet, does anyone have any suggestions?
